core_obligations: Reduce to a finite subset and show each finite subset is contained in a subalgebra which is a global complete intersection over the base, treating the separable case by the cited smoothness result (proof lines 44752-44760).

In the general case choose a transcendence basis, adjoin its elements and then a single element with a polynomial relation according to the algebraic part, obtaining the displayed global complete intersection (proof lines 44760-44775).
proof_roadmap: Reduce to one finite subset and handle the separable case (proof lines 44751-44760).
Build the complete intersection subalgebra from a transcendence basis (proof lines 44760-44776).
difficulty_reason: The lemma states that a field extension is a filtered colimit of global complete intersection algebras over the base, and of smooth algebras when the extension is separable (statement lines 44743-44749). The proof does not construct a presentation of the whole extension: it reduces to a single finite subset, disposes of the separable case by the corresponding smoothness statement, and in general exhibits a subalgebra generated by a transcendence basis plus one algebraic element subject to a polynomial relation, which is visibly a global complete intersection (proof lines 44751-44776). Reducing the whole extension to one finite subset at a time is what makes the construction finite. H2.
